_meta.coverage_metric: exact-subject binding, realm/boundary/flow closure, state and invariant references, required-capability gating, teardown symmetry, performance measurement closure, and evidence-state separation
_meta.purpose: Prove that an expert-sounding systems specification cannot advance to implementation while substrate capabilities, invariant oracles, lifecycle cleanup, state references, or performance evidence remain hollow.

runnable.hollow_fixture: runtime mutations that remove an invariant oracle or teardown ledger, advance an unexercised capability to READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, add a vague low-latency claim, make PASS evidence-free, or introduce dangling state/transition references
covers: the exact subject has a revision and lowercase SHA-256 digest
realms, boundaries, flows, states, resources, and teardown references close
every hard invariant has an enforcement owner, executable or planned oracle, and named failure state
required capability and assumption states gate READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION
every lifecycle-owned resource has normal and crash teardown plus a leak oracle
performance claims require metric, target, percentile, load model, environment identity, measurement method, and repetitions
PASS and FAIL require evidence while absence and non-execution remain distinct
a missing contract file is an input error rather than a failed system
runnable.expected: canonical prototype contract admitted; each planted hollow or contradictory mutation refused with a stable reason
